title: Understanding the Model
text: Consider how the model function \( \hat{y}_i=f_{\theta}(x_i)=\theta e**{\sqrt{|x_i|}} \) behaves. What happens to \( \hat{y}_i \) when \( $$x_i$$ \) is negative or positive? Think about the role of the absolute value and the exponential function.

title: Ordinary Least Squares (OLS)
text: OLS is a method used to estimate the parameters in a linear regression model. Consider how the model \( \hat{y}_i=f_{\theta}(x_i)=\theta e**{\sqrt{|x_i|}} \) might be linear in terms of \( $$\theta$$ \).

hintAnswer: The sum of residuals of our model will always be $$0$$.
title: Exploring Residuals
text: Which of the following is true about the sum of residuals in a model estimated using OLS?
choices: The sum of residuals of our model will always be $$0$$.
The sum of residuals of our model will always be positive.
The sum of residuals of our model will always be negative.

hintAnswer: The predictions of our model can never be negative.
title: Model Predictions
text: Consider the expression \( \hat{y}_i=\theta e**{\sqrt{|x_i|}} \). Which of the following statements about the predictions is true?
choices: The predictions of our model can never be negative.
The predictions of our model can be negative.
The predictions of our model are always positive.
